{{Quote|You bring credits?|translated=1|Pliktu|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Pliktu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He had a small shop in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], located near [[Anchorhead Spaceport|the spaceport]], where he sold [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pliku first appeared ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears as a starship upgrade vendor in Anchorhead on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR" />
